title: HighRes® and Opentrons® Announce Strategic Partnership to Launch the Industry’s First AI Agent-to-Agent Lab Automation Workflow
summary: Joint collaboration unites powerful robotics with AI-driven orchestration to redefine how labs scale automation BEVERLY, MA and NEW YORK (February 4, 2026) — HighRes, Inc., a leader in laboratory automation and orchestration software, and Opentrons Labworks, Inc., the leading laboratory robotics company building the physical infrastructure for AI-driven autonomous science, today announced a strategic partnership […] The post HighRes® and Opentrons® Announce Strategic Partnership to Launch the Industry’s First AI Agent-to-Agent Lab Automation Workflow appeared first on Opentrons .
